fields.commit: git commit served by Cloudflare Pages (the same id /api/open/build reports)
fields.live_seen: when the deploy guard saw it live and ran its smoke checks
fields.worker_tree: git tree id of the _worker.js directory: the exact worker source that Pages bundles
fields.worker_bytes: sum of the worker source files, bytes

how_recorded: Backfilled on 19 Nov 2026 from the git history of every deploy the guard recorded in /data/deploys.json. From then on the deploy guard (the existing scheduled job, /open/deploy-guard.py) adds worker_tree and dataset_sha256 to each deploy it checks.
